title: QDrone1 Cobra 2208 motor parametrization — physical StepsTest
creator: Quanser Consulting Inc.
rights: Root BSD-3-Clause software license, copyright 2025 Quanser Consulting Inc. No additional CSV-specific license identified. Only original aggregate statistics are distributed.
evidence: One stepped CSV recorded in 2021 has repeated ESC pulse sequences and signed thrust in N, torque in N·m, electrical and optical speed in rad/s. In the companion MATLAB file, a motor torque constant is calculated from nominal KV while Motor_torque uses Torque_data. These definitions should not be conflated.
fixed_file_url_rule: Append each file path, percent-encoded one segment at a time, to https://github.com/quanser/Quanser_Academic_Resources/blob/6adbceff7d2630ef35f61ddc7370be387bf03f4d/
scope: Bench-level inspection of command and independent physical measurements for R2. No flight deployment or controller optimization.
joined_input_boundary: These sources do not establish an upstream unclamped torque demand, its post-limiter command and an independently calibrated shaft torque on a common time base.
